description: This Java class defines a test activity for measuring the performance of launching a simple activity within the Android framework. It extends a base class for launch performance testing, sets up the intent for the target activity, and performs launch and finish operations.

classes.name: SimpleActivityLaunchPerformance
classes.description: An instrumentation class for performance testing the launch of a simple activity in Android.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the performance test class.
